name: Artificial Construct
description: A golem forged from iron and arcane will. Normal food provides only 25% nourishment — iron ingots and blocks are their true fuel, granting Regeneration III when consumed. Devour enough iron to permanently upgrade across five tiers (5/5/5/10/10%), reaching +35% to HP, melee, reduction, and toughness. Extended reach, natural armor, and reduced fall damage.
